events.title: Direct clone ingress closure passed same-chat and fresh-chat controls
events.epistemic_basis: After restoring direct clone ingress, the same-chat control completed 10/10 starts and 10/10 original-ID reads, the fresh-chat control completed 5/5 starts and 5/5 original-ID reads, both with zero drops/retries, and the three OAuth/OpenID metadata endpoints returned HTTP 200.
events.symptom: Client-visible process calls and original-ID reads completed cleanly after direct ingress restoration.

events.title: Single-front-door clone routing identified as the documented regression boundary
events.epistemic_basis: The study correlates the preserved Aug-27 rollback state, zero clone-a arrivals at the 3003 front door during the good period, Sep-1 commits 412c566 and 8413054 that promoted single-front-door routing, and the clean direct-route restoration. Together these support identifying the later single-front-door canonicalization as the regression boundary rather than treating chronology alone as causal proof.
events.symptom: A failed Aug-27 front-door clone experiment later became documented as the canonical production model.
events.result: Treat the single-front-door regression boundary as an evidence-backed inference, not an automatically observed fact.
